title: Delivery
description: One event on a subscriber's stream. Validating against the document itself validates a Delivery.

Delivery.description: One event on a subscriber's stream: the stamped envelope, the seal over it, and the payload. Open to unknown fields. Delivery semantics are unspecified at this contract version: live subscribers only, with no durability, ordering, redelivery, or acknowledgement promised.

seal.description: The seal over the envelope. Opaque: forward it unchanged in inbound, and never treat it as proof you can check.

payload.description: Any JSON value, opaque to the platform. The platform never inspects or classifies it.
